Product Description

Elevate your outdoor space with the VOLT® MR11 Decorative Rock Light, a discreet low voltage landscape lighting fixture designed to blend naturally into your surroundings. Its epoxy resin body with a cast brass faceplate creates a realistic rock appearance that works beautifully among shrubs, small trees, and garden beds. The adjustable gimbal gives you control over the direction of the light, while the customizable MR11 LED bulb lets you choose the brightness and color temperature that best fits your landscape. With its natural appearance and versatile design, this rock light makes it easy to add subtle landscape accent lighting without taking attention away from the beauty of your outdoor space.

Key Features

  • Blends Into the Landscape: The decorative rock design helps the fixture integrate naturally into garden beds and planted areas for a more seamless lighting installation.
  • Customizable MR11 Lighting: Choose from compatible MR11 LED bulbs with different lumens, beam angles, and color temperatures, including options for warm white and RGBCW color changing illumination.
  • Flexible Light Direction: The adjustable gimbal allows you to aim the light output toward shrubs, small trees, or other landscape features you want to highlight.
  • Easy Ground Placement: A 5" ground stake is included, along with a 4 ft. cUL certified 18AWG lead wire, providing convenient placement within your landscape.
  • Ready for Outdoor Conditions: The fixture operates at 12VAC and features a clear flat glass lens, IP67 protection, UL and cUL® listing, and a Lifetime Warranty for dependable outdoor use.
 
 

Applications (Ideal Uses)

Uplighting Your Home
Position at the base of a wall (6in-1ft away) to highlight architectural features such as small open wall spaces and columns, or small features such as statuary or fountains - use narrow beam spreads (38°) for narrow features such as columns, and wider beam spreads for open wall spaces (60°). Use with a gutter mount for dormers or gables.

Uplighting Small Landscaping
Ideal for precision accent lighting on smaller landscape features such as small trees, shrubs or planter pots - use narrow beam spreads (38°) for narrow features, and wider beam spreads (60°) for wider features.
